As for me, I regard myself as your most honored ambassador, and will love you as next of kin. Where you are, is abundance; where I am, each feels himself gloriously blest. And yet, confused by this contrary life, man often hesitates: whether to follow you and live a life of ease, or me, and never cease to strive for the new. I never act in secret. Even with only a breath I give myself away. Farewell, now! I know you wish me happiness, but if ever you want me back, just whisper, and I'll be here.

@@U02439@@
(Exit the BOY CHARIOTEER in the chariot.)

@@U02441@@
It is time to release our treasures from captivity. I strike the locks with the herald’s staff, and open it flies! See there! Molten gold, red as blood, bubbling up in brazen kettles
translation:
@@U02438@@
至于我，我视自己为你们最尊贵的大使，并会像亲人一样爱你们。有你在的地方，就是富足；在我所在的地方，每个人都感到自己受到了极大的祝福。然而，在这种相反的生活中，人常常会犹豫：是跟着你过安逸的生活，还是跟随我，永不停息地追求新的。我从来不秘密行事。即使只有一口气，我也会暴露自己。再见，现在！我知道你希望我幸福，但如果你想让我回来，只要低声说，我就会在这里。

@@U02439@@
（战车上的战童童子下。）
